# myPOS SDK Configuration
# Copy this file to .env and fill in your actual values

# ===========================================
# ENVIRONMENT SELECTION
# ===========================================
# Choose which environment to use: sandbox, demo, or production
MYPOS_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox

# ===========================================
# SANDBOX ENVIRONMENT (Default - Safe for Testing)
# ===========================================
# These are the default sandbox credentials - safe to use for testing
MYPOS_SID_SANDBOX=000000000000010
MYPOS_CLIENT_NUMBER_SANDBOX=61938166610
MYPOS_CURRENCY_SANDBOX=EUR
MYPOS_KEY_INDEX_SANDBOX=1
# Private key for sandbox - you can use the default one below
MYPOS_PRIVATE_KEY_SANDBOX=-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----------END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----

# ===========================================
# DEMO ENVIRONMENT
# ===========================================
# Get these from your myPOS account dashboard
MYPOS_SID_DEMO=your_demo_sid
MYPOS_CLIENT_NUMBER_DEMO=your_demo_wallet
MYPOS_CURRENCY_DEMO=EUR
MYPOS_KEY_INDEX_DEMO=1
MYPOS_PRIVATE_KEY_DEMO=your_demo_private_key_here

# ===========================================
# PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT
# ===========================================
# Get these from your myPOS account dashboard - USE WITH CAUTION!
MYPOS_SID_PRODUCTION=your_prod_sid
MYPOS_CLIENT_NUMBER_PRODUCTION=your_prod_wallet
MYPOS_CURRENCY_PRODUCTION=EUR
MYPOS_KEY_INDEX_PRODUCTION=1
MYPOS_PRIVATE_KEY_PRODUCTION=your_prod_private_key_here

# ===========================================
# CALLBACK URLs
# ===========================================
# URLs where users will be redirected after payment operations
# These should be URLs on your website that handle the responses
MYPOS_OK_URL=http://localhost:3000/success
MYPOS_CANCEL_URL=http://localhost:3000/cancel
MYPOS_NOTIFY_URL=http://localhost:3000/notify

# ===========================================
# ALTERNATIVE: PRIVATE KEY FILES
# ===========================================
# Instead of putting private keys in .env, you can use .pem files:
# - private_key.pem (default for all environments)
# - private_key_sandbox.pem (sandbox-specific)
# - private_key_demo.pem (demo-specific)
# - private_key_production.pem (production-specific)
# 
# The SDK will automatically look for these files if MYPOS_PRIVATE_KEY_* is not set
# Format: Standard PEM format RSA private key
